userdoc.notice: A garden of gardens. Each garden planted here costs 0.01 ETH —         the payment is the gesture, the garden is the mark.         Implements Sculpture so the factory itself is a sculpture whose         "sculptures" are the gardens deployed through it. The garden         registry IS the guestbook: each entry records who planted what,         when, and with which symbol.         Individual gardens still have their own FlowerGuestbook for visitors.         This contract does not inherit FlowerGuestbook — the act of         deploying a garden IS planting a flower here.
